MonoBehaviour Awake.description: Awake is called when the script instance is being loaded.

MonoBehaviour FixedUpdate.description: This function is called every fixed framerate frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

MonoBehaviour LateUpdate.description: LateUpdate is called every frame, if the Behaviour is enabled. It is called after all Update functions have been called.

MonoBehaviour OnApplicationFocus.description: Callback sent to all game objects when the player gets or loses focus.

MonoBehaviour OnApplicationPause.description: Callback sent to all game objects when the player pauses.

MonoBehaviour OnApplicationQuit.description: Callback sent to all game objects before the application is quit.

MonoBehaviour OnDestroy.description: This function is called when the MonoBehaviour will be destroyed.

MonoBehaviour OnDisable.description: This function is called when the behaviour becomes disabled or inactive.

MonoBehaviour OnEnable.description: This function is called when the object becomes enabled and active.

MonoBehaviour OnValidate.description: Called when the script is loaded or a value is changed in the inspector (Called in the editor only).

MonoBehaviour Reset.description: Reset is called when the user hits the Reset button in the Inspector's context menu or when adding the component the first time.

MonoBehaviour Start.description: Start is called on the frame when a script is enabled just before any of the Update methods is called the first time.

MonoBehaviour Update.description: Update is called every frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

MonoBehaviour OnTransformChildrenChanged.description: Called when the list of children of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

MonoBehaviour OnTransformParentChanged.description: Called when the parent property of the transform of the GameObject has changed.
